opening_message:
Ticket 1: Matthew Mejia (employee ID E034) requests write access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E034.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Matthew Mejia (E034) is a full-time Analyst. Requested write access to Payroll. Full-time employees can have up to write, and admin requires the Payroll Specialist role, so write is within policy. Recommend granting write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows Matthew Mejia (E034) is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training. Basic training means max is read. Requested write exceeds the max, so recommend granting read.
reason: HR (authoritative for employment records) indicates Matthew Mejia (E034) is a full-time Analyst. Per policy, full-time employees may have up to write, and admin requires owning the Payroll Specialist role, which the Analyst role does not hold. The requested write access is at the maximum allowed level, so write is granted. (Note: Security's record conflicts on employment type; HR's employment data is used as the basis for employment status.)
